notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
-added opening cutscene
-made cutscene skippable
-fixed bug that caused crashing when switching scenes
-fixed bug where game saves wouldnt update to steam cloud
-dialogue tweaks
-removed plot holes
-added directx12 support
-added webgl build for development and beta testing purposes (not for general public)
-reworked characters
-changed several store page and library assets
-planned release as soon as september
